thread:
maya: Kicking off staged rollout v2.3.1 -> 5% eu-west. Change window 18:00-19:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1 :rocket:
alex: 5% only? any reason not 10%?
maya: conservative bc last bake had a small CPU tail in eu-west. want quick signal before broader shift.
deploy-bot: deploybot: rollout started — canary=canary-8912 target=eu-west percent=5 image=redwood/v2.3.1
ops_doug: pls confirm rollback triggers and pin plan. if we hit faults we pin traffic to v2.3.0 and stop the ramp, right?
sre_jen: Agreed. Rollback triggers: >=0.5% 5xx above baseline OR p95 latency +10% sustained for 5m. On trigger: set route pin to redwood/v2.3.0, scale down new canaries, run quick healthcheck.
pm_lucas: Release notes include the KV cache fix and a small tokenizer tweak (no API changes). Added notes on expected perf impact.
alex: I'll monitor p95 and error tokenization spikes. If we see kvcache OOM pattern (see last run), call hold immediately.
maya: ops_doug you ok to perform pin/rollback if we call it?
ops_doug: Yep — I'll be ready. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
maya: If no signals in 10m we'll bump to 20%. deploy-bot, schedule bump at +10m unless hold flag set.
deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled bump_to=20% at +10m unless hold=true — will post update when bump starts
sre_jen: Dashboards to watch: /dash/rollout/v2.3.1 (errors, p50/p95, kvcache evictions). Logging stream: prod-rollout-canary.
alex: ack. Ping me @alex on any 5xx >0.2% or p95 jump >8%.
maya: thanks all — will post a quick summary at +5m and after bump. :wave:
